items.summary: Recommendation: keep private launch gates unchanged and external outreach unsent. Official upstream materials establish API access mechanics, not public or commercial reuse rights; four SearchWoot legal tasks remain open. Continue the existing consolidated rights, data-flow, consent, vendor, and retention evidence bundle.

Risk disposition: blocked for public launch, gated-product exposure, rights-dependent monetization, affiliate expansion, advertising, and alert expansion; conditional for ordinary reversible growth that preserves evidenced consent, disclosures, affiliate disclosures, claims, provenance, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries. Exact decision: keep private launch gates unchanged, keep external outreach unsent, and continue only existing bounded read-only evidence work. Evidence: upstream API materials establish access mechanics but not rights to store, transform, cache, display, retain historical data, send alerts, use images/trademarks/prices, or monetize; compliance is a technical baseline with 37 pass, 15 fail, and 7 unknown, including open banner, consent, analytics, privacy, and terms findings; security, accuracy/freshness, attribution, measurement, and owner gates remain incomplete. Human counsel is required for upstream rights, jurisdiction-specific privacy treatment, and any public-display, affiliate, advertising, or alert-expansion decision.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 legal tasks are closed and 4 remain open. No task is closable on current evidence. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only evidence bundle and field-level rights matrix covering provenance, permitted storage/display/alerts, freshness, correction, takedown, identifiers, retention, deletion, access, notification consent, unsubscribe behavior, GA4 settings, log fields, vendor/DPA coverage, and incident/request procedures. Do not send outreach, enable tracking, expand alerts, change the private gate, or expand monetization.

Data-use review: Woot API deal and price-history data is counsel_required and launch-blocked; user alert rules and sync results are evidence_needed; GA4 analytics is evidence_needed; operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data are evidence_needed. No item is clear or conditionally launchable on current evidence.
